related.title: 德基水力發電系統
related.why: 可遷移能量守恆、熱路、載荷與驗證證據；熱源、工作流體及安全邊界不同。
related.whyEn: Energy conservation, heat paths, loads and validation evidence transfer, with different heat sources, fluids and safety boundaries.
related.transfer: 可遷移能量守恆、熱路、載荷與驗證證據；熱源、工作流體及安全邊界不同。
related.transferEn: Energy conservation, heat paths, loads and validation evidence transfer, with different heat sources, fluids and safety boundaries.
related.difference: 本課針對多機組、水庫、灌溉與抽水協作；德基水力發電系統改以薄拱壩與大甲溪級聯能量為架構重點，不能直接沿用幾何、邊界或產品數值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on multiple units, reservoir, irrigation and pumping; Techi Hydropower System centers on thin-arch dams and dajia cascade energy, so geometry, boundaries and product values cannot transfer unchanged.
practice: 對照Coulee流量水頭與德基有效水頭，重畫兩項工程的輸入及系統邊界。
把本課假想算例移到德基水力發電系統，列出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以生態與泥砂指標為起點，設計一項能區分「多機組、水庫、灌溉與抽水協作」與「薄拱壩與大甲溪級聯能量」的觀測，註明不確定度。
practiceEn: Compare coulee flow/head with techi effective head and redraw inputs and boundaries.
Transfer the assumed example to Techi Hydropower System, separating reusable equations from respecified parameters.
Start from ecology/sediment metrics and propose an observation distinguishing multiple units, reservoir, irrigation and pumping from thin-arch dams and dajia cascade energy, including uncertainty.

related.title: 明潭抽蓄水力發電廠
related.why: 可遷移能量守恆、熱路、載荷與驗證證據；熱源、工作流體及安全邊界不同。
related.whyEn: Energy conservation, heat paths, loads and validation evidence transfer, with different heat sources, fluids and safety boundaries.
related.transfer: 可遷移能量守恆、熱路、載荷與驗證證據；熱源、工作流體及安全邊界不同。
related.transferEn: Energy conservation, heat paths, loads and validation evidence transfer, with different heat sources, fluids and safety boundaries.
related.difference: 本課針對多機組、水庫、灌溉與抽水協作；明潭抽蓄水力發電廠改以上下池、可逆機組與往返效率為架構重點，不能直接沿用幾何、邊界或產品數值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on multiple units, reservoir, irrigation and pumping; Mingtan Pumped Storage Power Plant centers on upper/lower pools, reversible units and round-trip efficiency, so geometry, boundaries and product values cannot transfer unchanged.
practice: 對照Coulee流量水頭與上下池淨水頭，重畫兩項工程的輸入及系統邊界。
把本課假想算例移到明潭抽蓄水力發電廠，列出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以生態與泥砂指標為起點，設計一項能區分「多機組、水庫、灌溉與抽水協作」與「上下池、可逆機組與往返效率」的觀測，註明不確定度。
practiceEn: Compare coulee flow/head with pool net head and redraw inputs and boundaries.
Transfer the assumed example to Mingtan Pumped Storage Power Plant, separating reusable equations from respecified parameters.

Start from ecology/sediment metrics and propose an observation distinguishing multiple units, reservoir, irrigation and pumping from upper/lower pools, reversible units and round-trip efficiency, including uncertainty.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 大古力水電站
history.text: 大古力水電站的公開資料展示多機組、水庫、灌溉與抽水協作的工程脈絡；本課以不同功能層與可驗證輸出重建教學案例，不宣稱取得任何專有製造流程。
history.textEn: Public sources for Grand Coulee Hydroelectric Power Plant illustrate multiple units, reservoir, irrigation and pumping. The course reconstructs functional layers and verifiable outputs educationally without proprietary manufacturing access.

history.title: 從工程故事到可檢查模型
history.titleEn: From engineering story to reviewable models
history.text: 本課將多機組、水庫、灌溉與抽水協作改寫為原創離線分析題；不複製來源的製造圖、影片逐字稿或現場程序。
history.textEn: The course turns multiple units, reservoir, irrigation and pumping into original offline analysis exercises without copying manufacturing drawings, video transcripts or field procedures.

roles.role: 承襲 GE 電力業務；GE 建造了 Grand Coulee 第三電廠三部 700 MW 機組。
roles.roleEn: Inherits GE’s power business; GE built three of the 700 MW Third Powerplant units.
roles.business: 供應燃氣／水力／風力發電設備、電網系統與 GE Hitachi 核能技術。
roles.businessEn: Supplies gas, hydro and wind power equipment, grid systems and GE Hitachi nuclear technology.

roles.role: 承襲 Siemens 發電業務；Siemens 曾將上述 GE 機組升級至 805 MW。
roles.roleEn: Inherits Siemens’ power-generation business; Siemens uprated those GE units to 805 MW.
roles.business: 發電與電網設備集團，旗下 Siemens Gamesa 供應離岸風機。
roles.businessEn: Power-generation and grid group whose Siemens Gamesa unit supplies offshore wind turbines.

courses.connection: 從「大古力水電站」的材料、設備、設計、量測或系統整合問題，延伸查閱下列公司與機構的官方資料；這是教材關聯，不代表合作、採購、背書或投資建議。
courses.connectionEn: Explore official information from companies and institutions related to the materials, equipment, design, measurement or system integration in Grand Coulee Hydroelectric Power Plant. This is a learning association, not a partnership, procurement, endorsement or investment advice.
